StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
-- NAVIGATE TO PATIENTS TAB AND REGISTER NEW PATIENT --
Click on Patients tab to navigate to Patients section
Wait for Patients tab to expand
Click on Patient task pane to open patient search
Wait for patient search form to load
Generate random surname for new patient
Enter random surname in patient search form
Click Find to search for patient record
Wait for search results to load
Handle no-records dialog and click Registration to initiate new patient registration
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient Forename
Enter random Surname
Click Postal Code lookup icon to open address lookup
Enter Postal Code
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Wait for address lookup results
Select address row from lookup results
Enter City
Select Country
Enter Home Telephone number
Enter Mobile Telephone number
Enter Email address
Click Next to proceed to the demographics section
Wait for demographics section to load
Select Communication Preference Type
Select Country of Birth
Select Nationality
Select Religion
Select Sexual Orientation
Select Ethnicity
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup to appear
Capture and store NHS Number allocated to patient
Verify NHS Number has been allocated and is not empty
Click OK to dismiss registration confirmation popup
-- FIND PATIENT RECORD USING FIND RECORD FEATURE --
Click Find Record link to open patient identifier search
Wait for Find Record search form to load
Enter captured NHS Number as identifier
Click Find to search by NHS Number
Wait for patient search results to load
Click patient surname link to open the specific patient record
Wait for EPR View to load
Confirm navigation to EPR View by verifying patient PAS ID is displayed
-- NAVIGATE TO PROCEDURE INTERVENTION EPR TAB --
Click Procedures and Interventions EPR tab
Wait for Procedures and Interventions view to load
Click Record Procedure link from context pane
Wait for Record Procedure form to load
Click Find icon to search for procedure name
Wait for procedure search form to load
Enter procedure search text
Click Search to find matching procedures
Wait for procedure search results
Select procedure term from search results
Click Add to add selected procedure to the form
Wait for procedure to be added
Click Finish Now to save the procedure record
Wait for procedure to be saved and EPR view to reload
Validate procedure details are stored by verifying Procedures and Interventions tab exists
-- NAVIGATE TO HEALTH ISSUES EPR TAB AND RECORD PROBLEMS --
Click Health Issues EPR tab to navigate to health issues section
Wait for Health Issues section to load
Click Problems tab within Health Issues section
Wait for Problems list to load
-- RECORD PROBLEM 1 --
Click New Problem button to open Problem 1 entry form
Wait for Problem Details form to load
Select Problem 1 Type
Click Select Problem icon to search for Problem 1 name
Enter Problem 1 name search text
Click Search to find matching problem terms
Wait for problem search results
Click OK to select the Problem 1 term
Check All Encounters and Episodes scope for Problem 1
Click Save to store Problem 1 details
Wait for Problem 1 to be saved
Validate Problem 1 is displayed in the Problems list with Active status
-- RECORD PROBLEM 2 --
Click New Problem button to open Problem 2 entry form
Wait for Problem Details form to load
Select Problem 2 Type
Click Select Problem icon to search for Problem 2 name
Enter Problem 2 name search text
Click Search to find matching problem terms for Problem 2
Wait for problem 2 search results
Click OK to select the Problem 2 term
Check All Encounters and Episodes scope for Problem 2
Click Save to store Problem 2 details
Wait for Problem 2 to be saved
Validate Problem 2 is displayed in the Problems list with Active status
-- MARK PROBLEM 1 AS MAIN PROBLEM --
Right-click Problem 1 in Problems list to open context menu
Wait for context menu to appear
Click Mark as Main Problem from context menu
Wait for scope selector to load after marking as main problem
Validate main problem icon is displayed correctly in scope selector
Click OK to confirm marking Problem 1 as Main Problem
Wait for main problem change to be applied
-- EDIT PROBLEM 2 - CHANGE ENCOUNTER TO EPISODE --
Double-click Problem 2 in Problems list to open in edit mode
Wait for Problem 2 details form to open in edit mode
Click Select Scope button to open scope selector
Wait for Scope selector to load
Click Expand Row to reveal the Episode scope entry
Select the Episode scope row
Click OK to confirm Episode scope selection
Wait for scope update to be applied to Problem 2
Click Save to store the encounter change for Problem 2
Wait for Problem 2 encounter update to be saved
Validate Problem 2 encounter change by verifying Problems tab exists
-- CHANGE PROBLEM 2 STATUS TO INACTIVE --
Double-click Problem 2 to reopen in edit mode for status change
Wait for Problem 2 details form to open
Click Status tab to navigate to the status change section
Wait for Status tab to load
Select Inactive as the new status for Problem 2
Select Reason for deactivating Problem 2
Click Save to apply Inactive status to Problem 2
Wait for Problem 2 status update to be saved
Enable Display Inactive Problems to validate status update
Wait for inactive problems to be displayed
Validate Problem 2 Inactive status by verifying inactive problems checkbox is active
-- LINK PROCEDURE TO PROBLEM 1 --
Right-click Problem 1 in Problems list to open context menu for linking
Wait for context menu to appear
Click Link option from context menu to link procedure to Problem 1
Wait for Link Problem form to load
Select Care Record Type to link
Click Add to create the link between Problem 1 and the Procedure
Wait for link to be created
Click Finish to save the procedure link for Problem 1
Wait for link to be saved and Problems list to reload
Validate procedure link by verifying Problems tab is still displayed
-- STRIKEOUT PROBLEM 1 --
Double-click Problem 1 to open in edit mode for strikeout
Wait for Problem 1 details form to open
Click Status tab to navigate to status change section
Wait for Status tab to load
Select Struck Out status to strikeout Problem 1
Click Save to apply strikeout status to Problem 1
Wait for strikeout to be applied
Enable Display Inactive Problems to validate strikeout status and icons
Wait for struck-out problems to be displayed
Validate strikeout icons and status by verifying inactive problems are displayed
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout icon to initiate logout from Lorenzo
Confirm logout by clicking Yes on the confirmation dialog
Wait for login page to confirm successful logout
